channels.label: The Long Form Interview Program That Never Ends

rules.name: All first
rules.statement: Every filter list carries All, in first position, as its default. Any is not used because it implies an unchosen subset.

rules.name: Declared sort
rules.statement: Every sibling list in a display is fully sorted by one declared key, written on the surface where a reader can check it.

rules.name: No junk drawer
rules.statement: An item belonging to an organization by its nature appears in it, never beside it.

rules.name: Text is black and big enough
rules.statement: Readable text is full-contrast; graying for style is prohibited; text below 16 px only where a hard constraint forces it, named at the use site.

rules.name: Layered ordering
rules.statement: A control that modifies another sits to its left; meaning-changers occupy the no-scroll zone; frequency orders the rest; alphabetical order only inside long option vocabularies.

rules.name: Trigger visible
rules.statement: Behavior that fires on its own is not shipped until the interface can show what triggered it.

rules.name: Reversal complete
rules.statement: Undoing an action restores every state the action's automatic side effects changed.

rules.name: Groupings earn existence
rules.statement: Any container at any level exists only if its members receive different treatment.

rules.name: Two-level default
rules.statement: A display of organized information shows the current parent and its immediate children; deeper levels only behind explicit expansion.

rules.name: Ordering determines control
rules.statement: A totally ordered variable is sortable; a nominal one is groupable.

rules.name: Bundled controls visible
rules.statement: A control may set other controls, but every value it sets displays in its own control, marked as a side-effect, and stays overridable.

rules.name: Gray only inactive
rules.statement: User-facing facts and active widgets are never gray; gray is reserved for disabled or inactive states.

rules.name: Post-conditions documented
rules.statement: Every GUI control carries a written post-condition in desc, args, pre, modifies, post form, written before the code.

rules.name: Metadata density
rules.statement: Visible metadata is chosen per audience, use-case, attention span and cost of time, with an override available.
